# NOVITA Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.

> NOVITA Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is a pharmaceutical manufacturer based in Yangon, Myanmar. It is a member of KTECG Group and is developing a GMP-compliant oral solid dosage manufacturing facility for tablets and hard gelatin capsules. Its stated purpose is to develop safe, effective, and accessible medicines for a healthier Myanmar.

## Company facts

- Legal name: NOVITA Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
- Short name: NOVITA
- Headquarters: No. 216/222 Bo Myat Htun Housing, Room D3, Corner of 49 Street and Maharbandoola Road, Ward 1, Pazundaung Township, Yangon, Myanmar
- Email: info@novita-myanmar.com.mm
- Phone: (+95) 9 5000144
- Factory phone: (+95) 9 977 225 001
- Website: https://novita-myanmar.com.mm/
- Industry: Pharmaceutical manufacturing
- Group affiliation: KTECG Group (https://www.kyawtharengg.com.mm)
- Manufacturing focus: Oral solid dosage (OSD) forms, including tablets and hard gelatin capsules
- Quality approach: Facility designed for international GMP standards, with quality control testing and a path toward PIC/S GMP certification
- Regulatory context: Products and facility are intended to comply with Myanmar FDA requirements

## Products and therapeutic focus

NOVITA's planned portfolio focuses on essential medicines in oral solid dosage forms. Therapeutic categories described on the website include cardiovascular, anti-infective, central nervous system, and respiratory medicines. Specific product information, indications, and availability are subject to Myanmar FDA approval and are not yet published.

### What does NOVITA manufacture?

NOVITA is developing a facility for oral solid dosage forms, including tablets and hard gelatin capsules, supported by a quality control laboratory.
